versions.content: If the parameter ComTxIPduClearUpdateBit of an I-PDU is configured to TriggerTransmit, the AUTOSAR COM module shall clear all update-bits of all contained signals and signal groups after the contents of this I-PDU was suc- cessfully requested by Com_TriggerTransmit.
